source_cfg: sha2 src/sha256.rs selects soft::compress before architecture-specific dispatch. No asm/force-soft-compact feature. Release compression symbol inlines selected soft source. Source selection alone is not no-SIMD proof.
release_findings: compress256 contains scalar integer instructions; c2_sha256_boundary final output packing contains punpckhbw/punpcklbw, pshuflw/pshufhw, packuswb. Compiler-generated packed operations do not establish a no-SIMD full hash path. Other movups/movaps and zeroing are separately incidental transfers/initialization.
proposal_limit: Review required before any changed-flag build. Disabling LLVM loop/SLP vectorizers is a candidate experiment, not a guarantee of no packed instructions from other lowering/stdlib. No ISA features disabled to evade ABI requirements.
